create_agent_with_disco_update_rule: create an Agent instance using the disco update rule with observation and action specs
create_agent_with_actor_critic_update_ru: create an Agent instance using the actor_critic update rule with observation and action specs
run_actor_step: run a single actor step to sample actions from the agent network for a timestep
run_learner_step: run a learner training step that computes gradients and updates agent parameters from a rollout
get_settings_disco: get the default Disco-103 configuration settings as a ConfigDict for agent initialization
